workResult: Completed Skill 03 source-complete Deep Reading for all three same-date selected objects after ordered Runtime authority and Worker Claimed were durably established. Q-20260820-01 verified that Codex removed Git from the known-safe command shortcut on Unix and Windows because repository configuration can redirect nominally read-only Git operations into helper execution; under UnlessTrusted, plain git status now requires approval unless an explicit execution-policy rule allows it, while OnRequest retains its own policy semantics and absolute-path tests distinguish declared host executables from unmatched Git paths. This establishes an effective-execution approval boundary, not a claim that every Git invocation is dangerous or that approval alone contains all side effects. Q-20260820-02 verified that Google ADK now scrubs credential-bearing request function calls from RemoteA2aAgent session-history reconstruction before other-agent rendering can inline their arguments; detection uses the known adk_request_credential name plus nested AuthConfig shape, preserves ordinary top-level auth_scheme calls, non-secret text siblings, the mock-auth prompt and the original local history, and keeps existing response-side credential filtering. This is a demonstrated remote-history projection boundary, not general A2A confidentiality or local secret-at-rest protection. Q-20260820-03 verified that ADK FileArtifactService now reserves hidden .{version}.pending directories, stages payload and metadata there, publishes only through one os.replace to the integer version name, cleans failed staging, avoids concurrent/stale-version collisions, intentionally permits version gaps from abandoned reservations, and explicitly does not provide fsync-backed power-loss durability. This is process-level atomic publication under the demonstrated filesystem model, not distributed transactionality or crash-consistent storage durability. Three durable Reading Notes were produced. No Research Analysis, article drafting, visualization or publication was performed.
workResult_zh: 仅在有序 Runtime 执行权与 Worker Claimed 均完成持久核验后，才对三个同日已选对象完成 Skill 03 Source-complete Deep Reading。Q-20260820-01 核验了 Codex 因仓库配置可能把名义只读 Git 操作重定向为 helper 执行，而在 Unix 与 Windows 路径上取消 Git 的 Known-safe 快捷分类；在 UnlessTrusted 下，普通 git status 现在需要审批，除非显式 Execution Policy Rule 允许；OnRequest 仍保留自己的策略语义，Absolute-path 测试也区分已声明 Host Executable 与未匹配的 Git 路径。该结论证明的是 Effective Execution 的审批边界，不是“所有 Git 调用都危险”，也不是“审批本身即可约束全部外部副作用”。Q-20260820-02 核验了 Google ADK 现在会在 RemoteA2aAgent 从 Session History 重建远端消息时，先于 Other-agent Rendering 清除携带凭据的 Request Function Call，避免参数被内联为文本后再处理；检测同时使用已知 adk_request_credential 名称与嵌套 AuthConfig Shape，并保留普通顶层 auth_scheme 调用、非秘密 Text Sibling、Mock-auth Prompt 与原始本地 History，同时继续保留既有 Response-side Credential Filtering。该机制证明的是远端 History Projection 的凭据清除边界，不是一般性的 A2A 机密性或本地 Secret-at-rest 保护。Q-20260820-03 核验了 ADK FileArtifactService 现在通过隐藏 .{version}.pending 目录预留版本，在其中写入 Payload 与 Metadata，最后仅通过一次 os.replace 把完整目录发布为整数版本；失败 Staging 会清理，并发写入与 Stale Version List 不再覆盖既有版本；Abandoned Reservation 会故意留下版本缺口，且实现明确没有 fsync 支持的断电持久性保证。该结论证明的是所示文件系统模型下的 Process-level Atomic Publication，不是分布式事务或 Crash-consistent Storage Durability。共形成 3 份持久 Reading Note。未执行 Research Analysis、文章写作、可视化或发布。
